certification.name: Certified Third Party Risk Professional
certification.description: Third-party risk management certification requiring five years of experience in a related role. The remotely proctored exam has 120 multiple-choice scenario questions and a 70% pass mark; holders earn 36 CPE credits per three-year term.
certification.currency_note: Non-member price of the self-study class, exam included; members $595. Annual maintenance fee $100
